subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the percentage increase in the price of crude oil on different days of a given week compared to its price on the previous day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf8e77974a372c5621cac3001dd870560e45e13ad1518b260c8493ada7d94172.png] 

If the price of crude oil at the end of Friday was Rs. 44,800 per barrel, then what was the price (per barrel) of crude oil at the end of Thursday?
solution:
**Calculation:**

If the price of crude oil at the end of Friday was ₹44,800 per barrel.

The price of crude oil at the end of Friday is 112% of the price of crude oil at the end of Thursday.

∴ The price of crude oil at the end of Thursday is 100%.

⇒ 112% = 44800

⇒ 100% = 44800/112 × 100

⇒ Rs. 40000

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
